Trusted exact source skeleton, AST translator, Python/NumPy/runtime and ordinary base arrays; helpers do not mutate shared inputs, primitive operations terminate, one writer, and final stores succeed uninterrupted for the narrow theorem. Instrumentation observes and injects an exception deliberately; no historical occurrence is claimed. Stronger atomicity remains a blocker. Trusted AST/model translation, ordinary base numeric arrays, stable bindings/constants and NumPy finite/first-argmax semantics; no full runtime or neural-policy refinement. The elapsed proof starts from the final scalar, not clock conversion or authenticity; measured time excludes later output validation and selection. Nonreturning forward has no preemption; proposal is not an authorized order. No staleness, uncertainty, policy quality, economic value or actual deadline guarantee.

Trusted AST translation, admitted base arrays, stable bindings and NumPy cumprod, reduction and broadcast semantics; no full runtime refinement. Exact-real algebra does not establish binary64 accuracy, unbiasedness, behavior support, confidence coverage or statistical reliability. Diagnostic remains disconnected from frozen OPE/training and production; no policy result is repaired or promoted.

Trusted Python/NumPy primitives, left-insertion search semantics, exact regular integer grids and stable ordinary source bindings; AST source binding/extraction is not full interpreter refinement. Hashes identify bytes, not publication timing, source truth or historical prevalence. No arbitrary-registration/CSV-schema, cash-realism or universal floating-point theorem.

Stable ordinary Replay state; returning and exception-free shield/observation/market/_trade/_risk primitives until the final reward check; Python control flow, AST translation and source-to-model abstraction trusted. Ghost admission/check tags record abstract ordering only. Helper attempts are not guaranteed fills. No numeric accounting, full runtime refinement, concurrency, physical deadline or production lifecycle proof.

The cutoff applies only to the pinned ordering abstraction. Stable ordinary dataclass attributes, standard replacement semantics, source/AST interpretation and all earlier A-REPLAY-ORDER helper assumptions are trusted. Actual time-to-end observations, numeric rewards, risk outcomes and policy actions can differ with remaining length. The integer branch lemma and finite lift checks are not universal interpreter refinement or an observation/reward bisimulation.

Exact-real arithmetic with positive starting/intermediate wealth for the product induction; complete source row publication, stable ordinary state, returning helpers and trusted Python/NumPy/AST semantics. Costs are nonnegative supplied vectors; fill quantities, fee formation and impact square roots are not proved. Real identities and synthetic tolerance tests do not establish universal binary64 error bounds, finite outputs, runtime refinement or economic superiority.

Trusted ordinary Python AST/identity/short-circuit execution, GHC constructors and guard order, defined arguments, returning monotonic clock; no runtime patching or compiler corruption. Explicit research command invocation opts into simulation; no production candidate integration exists.
